questions.question: When was lisinopril first started, and at what dose?
Was the lisinopril dose increased from 10 mg to 20 mg, and if so, when and by whom?
What was the patient's blood pressure before starting lisinopril, and how has it trended since initiation?
Has dizziness been documented before starting lisinopril, or is it new onset?
Were any actions taken in response to the low BP (98/62) or dizziness—e.g., dose reduction, hold, or monitoring plan?
Is there documentation of renal function or potassium levels around lisinopril initiation or dose change?
